title: The Curious Life of House Cats
caption:
FROM A PAPER BAG TO PLAYTIME. A new edit of independent real cat recordings. #WildVox #CatBehavior #Cats

narration_timeline.text: A paper bag catches this cat's attention, and it leans inside to explore.
Elsewhere, a fluffy kitten rests quietly, showing a much calmer moment.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual separate resting kitten in Tokyo

narration_timeline.text: A black cat strolls past the camera, while another cat takes its time grooming its fur.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate genuine black walking cat and self-grooming cat

narration_timeline.text: Then one cat paws at a cotton bud, while a different pair begins playing together indoors.
narration_timeline.scene: Cat batting cotton bud and pair playing

narration_timeline.text: Another indoor cat rolls onto its side and stretches its paws, enjoying a playful moment.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual indoor cat rolls across floor and stretches paws; no unverified toy tracking

narration_timeline.text: Outdoors, a final cat relaxes under gentle petting, ending this tour of very different moods.
narration_timeline.scene: Different outdoor cat receiving human pat
